text: In the Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task titled 'fwop13-n1 Bench Work Package' with a description containing the text fwop13-n1 (e.g. 'Bench work package for run fwop13-n1'). Then set the assignee to the existing user 'Bench Assignee' via the assignee autocomplete (type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown — not just typing), set status to 'In progress', and set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Fields save in place without a page-wide Save button; wait for each to save. Then verify on the work package page that the assignee is Bench Assignee, status is In progress, and finish date is 2026-12-31, and report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (#number).
